task: Audit the List Directory Layout for brand, content, and UX/tech compliance.

findings.reasoning: The Tailwind configuration defines marigold as #EAA92A and custom CSS uses #EAA92A. However, the Brand Playbook specifies Marigold / Burnt Honey as #C97138. Confidence: high.
The Tailwind configuration assigns the 'Inter' font to 'label-caps' (used for eyebrows). The Brand Playbook mandates 'IBM Plex Mono' for eyebrows and labels. Confidence: high.
The word 'immersive' is used in the Emerging Leaders Programme description ('immersive workshops'). 'immersive' is explicitly listed as a banned word in the Voice & Tone guidelines. Confidence: high.
findings.element: article for Emerging Leaders Programme (paragraph text)
findings.required: replace with an active verb or concrete noun

findings.reasoning: Row 3 (Emerging Leaders) uses a hardcoded background color of #EBE5D6. This is not in the approved palette (Parchment is #F4EFE3). Confidence: high.
According to Section 4.1, PCAIM duration is 10 months. The HTML prototype shows '12 WEEKS'.
findings.detail: PCAIM duration is incorrect (shows 12 WEEKS instead of 10 months).

findings.reasoning: According to Section 4.2, PCHM duration is 10 months. The HTML prototype shows '6 MONTHS'.
findings.detail: PCHM duration is incorrect (shows 6 MONTHS instead of 10 months).

findings.reasoning: According to Section 4.3, ELP duration is 7 months. The HTML prototype shows '1 YEAR'.
findings.detail: ELP duration is incorrect (shows 1 YEAR instead of 7 months).

findings.reasoning: The Directory Stats section displays fabricated metrics such as '98% Placement Rate'. Section 4.2 states PCHM has no formal placement.
findings.detail: Fabricated statistics in Directory Stats section including 98% placement rate.

findings.reasoning: The instructions state that mandatory sections include Hero, Faculty, and FAQs. The HTML lacks Faculty and FAQs sections. Since it's a directory page, they may not be applicable, so confidence is low.
findings.detail: Missing Faculty and FAQs sections on the page.

findings.reasoning: Section 4.6 specifies 5 Core Programmes to Feature. The HTML includes a 6th programme: Corporate Governance & Ethics. This is extra content.
findings.detail: Included 'Corporate Governance & Ethics' which is not among the 5 core programmes specified for the listing page.

findings.reasoning: VIEWPORT_SPEC.md states 'max-width: NONE on <body> or <main>'. The <main> element has the Tailwind class 'max-w-[1200px]', restricting its width.
findings.issue: main element has max-width restricted to 1200px instead of none

findings.reasoning: VIEWPORT_SPEC.md states 'Content container: max-width: 1200px, margin: 0 auto, padding: 0 48px'. The containers (<nav>, <main>) use 'px-margin-desktop' which is 64px.
findings.issue: Content container has horizontal padding of 64px instead of 48px

findings.reasoning: VIEWPORT_SPEC.md states 'Section padding: 80px top/bottom minimum'. The <main> tag uses 'py-stack-xl' (64px) and the <section> uses 'py-stack-lg' (32px).
findings.issue: Section vertical padding is 32px, below the 80px minimum

findings.reasoning: The element uses 'data-alt' instead of the standard 'alt' attribute, which is not read by screen readers.
There are multiple 'Learn More' buttons without aria-labels. Screen reader users won't know what they are learning more about.
The HTML document is missing a <meta name="description"> tag, which is essential for SEO.

Checked colors, fonts, and voice. White background is explicitly allowed via override. Charcoal (#1A1B1E) and Marigold (#C97138) are correctly applied. No banned colors found. Fonts are strictly followed (Source Serif 4, Inter, IBM Plex Mono). Voice & tone is compliant with no banned words, and 'The same faculty. Wherever you are.' is present.
The HTML prototype is missing the FAQs section which is expected per the standard page structure.
The HTML prototype is missing the Testimonials section.
The HTML prototype is missing the Fee / dates information.
The Eligibility section in the HTML only mentions '3 Years Exp.' while Section 4.1 specifies 'Min. 3 years professional experience · Graduate degree in any discipline'.
findings.detail: Missing Graduate degree requirement in Eligibility.

findings.reasoning: The footer includes the email but is missing Phone and WhatsApp numbers, as well as Office Hours specified in Section 4.1.
findings.detail: Missing phone and WhatsApp contact details.

findings.reasoning: VIEWPORT_SPEC.md states 'Content container: max-width: 1200px'. The layout containers in nav, header, and sections use the Tailwind class max-w-7xl, which maps to 1280px.
VIEWPORT_SPEC.md states 'Content container: padding: 0 48px'. The containers use px-6 md:px-8 which translates to 32px horizontal padding on desktop.
findings.issue: Content container horizontal padding is 32px instead of 48px

findings.reasoning: VIEWPORT_SPEC.md states 'Hero section: CSS Grid, 2 columns, gap: 64px minimum'. The hero wrapper uses Flexbox (flex-col md:flex-row) with gap-12 (48px).
findings.issue: Hero uses flex instead of grid and gap is less than 64px

findings.reasoning: VIEWPORT_SPEC.md states 'Hero left col: ~55% width'. The HTML uses w-full md:w-1/2 (50%).
findings.issue: Hero left column is 50% instead of 55%

findings.reasoning: VIEWPORT_SPEC.md states 'Hero right card: ~40% width'. The HTML uses w-full md:w-1/2 (50%).
findings.issue: Hero right column is 50% instead of 40%

findings.reasoning: The HTML document is missing a <meta name="description"> tag, which is essential for SEO.
Decorative SVGs should have aria-hidden="true" to prevent screen readers from announcing them unnecessarily.
